purpose: Expose deterministic verification, relation, phrase, lexeme, and score-policy audits, evaluation, mutation, diacritization, contract, corpus, split-grouping, and knowledge-root commands.
invariants: Missing or invalid inputs produce explicit failure.
Evaluation gates return non-zero when their validity contract fails.
Audit output separates accepted and deferred evidence.
Lexeme audits fail when a registered parser collection lacks provenance policy.
Score-policy output binds every selection constant, rationale, beam bound, and tie-breaker.
Identical source and input bytes produce byte-identical reports.
verification: All synchronized v4 evidence commands completed
All report and generated-artifact replay pairs matched
claimBoundary: Offline research and verification CLI; not a production service API.
